subject: Hotpath surge + throughput collapse after v4.1-q8 deploy — CTO brief requested
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@altoinsurance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@altoinsurance.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: sharp latency increase + 500s starting 08:50 PT (post-deploy)

Jordan —

We're seeing a severe impact in our production inference pipeline starting ~08:50 PT after your team's change earlier this morning (v4.1 with q8 profile). Symptoms: p50 up ~30%, p95 doubled, and 3% 500s across model endpoints. Throughput dropped by ~40% vs baseline despite traffic volume being steady. This is affecting our policy underwriting flow; you can see user-facing errors in the attached sample spans and traces.

We need an immediate mitigation: either rollback to the previous model/profile or route traffic off the impacted pool. Alto cannot absorb SLA misses here — please advise ETA for a fix and whether you can initiate an emergency rollback now. Our CTO is requesting an executive update.

Attachments: alto_prod_20270507_08-55_trace.log, request-err-samples.jsonl

Alex Turner
Dir. Platform Eng, Alto Insurance
alex.turner@altoinsurance.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@altoinsurance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:28:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sharp latency increase + 500s starting 08:50 PT (post-deploy)

Alex — thanks for the quick flag and the logs. I see you copied Sam — appreciate the samples.

I've looped in Marissa from Infra and Grace from Customer Success to triage and coordinate an immediate mitigation plan. Short answers: we can (A) attempt a config rollback of the qprofile on your dedicated pool, or (B) route traffic to the last-known-good model variant in our hosted fleet while we investigate. Both take ~10-40 minutes depending on approval and capacity.

Marissa / Grace — can you take point? Alex wants an exec-friendly brief for their CTO; Jordan will coordinate comms. Alex — can you confirm greenlight for rollback if engineering recommends it?

-Jordan
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@altoinsurance.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sharp latency increase + 500s starting 08:50 PT (post-deploy)

Jordan / Alex — initial triage from infra: the telemetry shows an unusually high KV cache miss rate and sustained decoding stalls on the GPU for requests hitting long-context prompts. The model selector appears to have chosen the q8 kernel path that, for v4.1, triggers a slower attention kernel on sequences >1024 tokens — that combination wasn't exercised in our preflight with Alto's dataset. In short: the qprofile/kernel pairing introduced a worst-case kernel that increases per-token compute for a subset of Alto requests.

Immediate recommended actions (doable now):
- Disable the new qprofile on Alto's dedicated pool (config flip) -> expected p95 improvement within 5-10 minutes once in-flight requests drain.
- If config flip is risky, reroute Alto's 100% traffic to the hosted v4.0-compatible variant (we have capacity) as temporary fallback (ETA ~15-30min to warm and move traffic).
- Collect a focused sample of 100 failing requests for offline root-cause analysis (Marissa/Infra will take).

We need explicit go-ahead from Alto to perform config change on their pool (it requires a rolling restart of serving pods). Alex — what is your preference? If you approve rollback, we'll schedule a 30-minute maintenance window and execute immediately.

Attaching triage note (summary) and asking infra to standby.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Inference Platforms, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@altoinsurance.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sharp latency increase + 500s starting 08:50 PT (post-deploy)

Alex — I'm opening an incident channel and a 30-minute maintenance window now. Plan:
- Stand up hosted fallback pool (v4.0-compatible) and begin gradual traffic shift 1/3 -> 2/3 -> 100% with health checks.
- If Alto approves config rollback, we'll flip qprofile and coordinate a rolling restart (expected <35 minutes).
- We'll throttle burst traffic and enable extra tracing to capture the failing request set for Marissa.

Jordan: I'll keep the Alto incident channel posted and coordinate a customer-facing timeline. Alex — can you grant us permission to flip the profile if Marissa recommends it? That will speed mitigation.

Link: Incident workspace: https://redwood.app/incident/ALTO-47

Thanks — Grace
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Samantha is copied earlier in the thread; Jordan will send the executive note to both Alex and Samantha once ready. Alex: we've told infra that we can proceed pending Marissa's confirmation of ETA.

-Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@altoinsurance.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@altoinsurance.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Alto incident executive brief and rollback plan (v4.1 qprofile)

Samantha / Alex — brief summary for your CTO: 

1) Impact summary
- Start: 2027-05-07 08:50 PT.
- Visible effects: p50 latency +28%, p95 latency +110%, 500-class errors ~3% across inference endpoints, throughput down ~40%.

2) Root-cause hypothesis (current)
- The v4.1 model with the new q8 quantization profile triggers an attention/decoder kernel path for sequences >1024 tokens that has substantially higher per-token latency for this workload. Combined with a spike in KV cache misses (Alto's request characteristics), it produced backpressure on the GPU and decoding stalls. This is most consistent with the telemetry and trace samples.

3) Immediate mitigation executed / planned
- Customer-approved action: disable v4.1-q8 profile on Alto's dedicated pool (config flip) — executing now. Expected user-facing restoration: 5-15 minutes after in-flight drain.
- Contingency: route traffic to hosted v4.0-compatible variant if rollback shows issues (warmup ETA ~15-30 minutes).
- We enabled extended tracing and saved the 100 failing-request sample for offline RCA. Attach: exec-brief-alto-20270507.pdf (contains charts and logs).

4) Timeline and responsibilities
- 15:48 PT — rollback started (Marissa / Infra).
- 16:03 PT — initial health check expected; 16:20 PT — full restoration expected barring unforeseen stateful cache rebuild delays.
- Post-mortem with RCA and test-gap plan scheduled within 48 hours.

5) Longer-term fixes under consideration
- Add qprofile compatibility tests covering long-context prompts and KV cache miss patterns for enterprise pools.
- Introduce a canary gate that exercises worst-case kernels under production-like request distributions before broad rollouts.
- Improve monitoring alert thresholds to detect early kernel-path regressions.

We will keep this channel updated with minute-by-minute status. Jordan will send this brief to your CTO as requested. Apologies for the disruption — we understand the operational impact and are prioritizing Alto across Infra leadership.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Inference Platforms, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: exec-brief-alto-20270507.pdf
